name: @quitegoodproject/landscope-sdk
description: High-performance PostGIS spatial parcel boundary, deed owner verification, zoning compliance, and solar roof feasibility engine.
author: The Quite Good Project <engineering@quitegoodproject.com>

tools.name: get_parcel_boundaries
tools.description: Fetch spatial parcel boundaries, APN, lot size, zoning code, and assessed value for any US address.

address.description: Street address (e.g. '4812 E 7th St, Austin, TX 78702')

tools.name: verify_deed_owner
tools.description: Verify whether an applicant is the legal deeded owner using Jaro-Winkler string distance.

applicant_name.description: Full legal name of the applicant

tools.name: calculate_solar_feasibility
tools.description: Calculate usable roof area, fire code setbacks, recommended system size in kW, and annual kWh generation.

tools.name: calculate_buildable_envelope
tools.description: Calculate parametric 2D buildable footprint, setbacks, and FAR headroom under municipal zoning codes.
